info.name: Tream API — Complete (M01–M14)
info.description: Complete Postman collection for local testing following all mounted API modules in apps/server (M01–M14). Import the accompanying local environment and run ONLY the 01 Smoke folder for an automatic end-to-end run. Other folders (02–19) are comprehensive manual recipes with stateful prerequisites covering Authentication, Workspaces, Memberships, Invitations, Lifecycle, Teams, Projects, Issues, Cycles, Collaboration, Private Files, Initiatives, Documents, Views & Search, Notifications, Audit History, Retention & Trash, and Eventing Outbox.

item.name: 08 Projects and milestones — manual
item.description: M06 recipes. Requires an active workspace and team. Project members require an accepted active non-guest workspace membership; adding/removing teams requires a second readable active team. Lifecycle recipes require no unfinished linked issues.

request.description: List project statuses

exec: pm.test('Success envelope', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b).to.have.property('data'); pm.expect(b.meta.requestId).to.be.a('string'); });

item.description: 12 mounted routes plus project/comment link and detachment examples (14 requests). Requires active workspace, shared source issue, accessible active project/comment and configured private storage/scanning adapters. Run intent → upload grant → raw PUT → finalize → grant → download in order. Every JSON mutation uses a fresh UUID and applicable expectedRevision. request.description: Requires an active accessible issue. Creates the immutable source attachment atomically with quota reservation. Declares exactly 23 bytes and SHA256 for the raw upload below; changing the payload requires changing both declarations.

Content-Type application/octet-stream; no JSON quotes, multipart envelope, Idempotency-Key or Origin header. Signed grant AND original bearer session are required. Repeating identical bytes is safe while the upload remains usable.
